toolbar.flag_copy_tip: Automatically copy the left flag to the right one (same alignment).
Disable to give the two halves different text.

about.title: About TuxLabel
about.body:
Editor for Brother PT-P700 labels (TZe tapes).

Author: Christoph Krogmann
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.title: Help
help.html: <html><body style='font-family: sans-serif;'>
TuxLabel — Quick guide
Editing a label
<ul>
• Insert text: In the Add tool area, click the
T icon (with the green +). Double-click a text box to
open the inline editor.
• Insert image: In the Add tool area, click the
image icon (with the green +) to load an image file.
With Ctrl+V you can paste images straight from the
clipboard.
• Move: Drag an element with the mouse or move it with
the arrow keys (Ctrl = fine step of 0.1 mm).
• Resize: Select an element and drag one of the blue
handles.
• Format painter: Select the source text box, click the
Format button, then click the target box.
Tape width and length
The tape width set in the toolbar must match the loaded TZe
tape – otherwise the PT-P700 blinks red. The ruler above the
label shows the current length in centimeters; with the
Auto button the label length grows automatically with
the content.
Managing files
<ul>
• File → Save stores the label as a
.ptle file (text, images, tape settings).
• File → Recent files gives quick access to recently
opened labels.
• File → Undo reverts the last change to the label
(up to 50 steps).
Printing
The Print button opens the print dialog. Select the
CUPS printer (PT-P700), check the tape width and print mode
(line = text, dithering = photo) and start printing.
A complete list of keyboard shortcuts is available under
Help → Keyboard shortcuts.
</body></html>
print.title: Print label
print.match: Only print if the tape width matches
print.match_tip_disabled:
Automatically disabled for {tape} mm tape.

Custom page sizes narrower than 12.7 mm are rounded up
to 12.7 mm by the PPD — the "tape width matches" check
then fails and the P700 blinks red.
print.match_tip:
Disable to print on a tape of a different width.
On a mismatch the P700 blinks red – disabling fixes that.
print.mode_tip:
Line mode: each pixel is turned black or white using a brightness threshold. Best choice for text.

Photo mode (dithering): gray levels are approximated with dot patterns (Floyd-Steinberg). Best choice for images/photos; text edges may look slightly grainy.
print.offset_tip:
Shifts the printed content vertically on the tape.
Negative = up, positive = down.

If content is cut off at the bottom edge (e.g. 'p' descenders):
try a small negative value (-0.3 to -0.8 mm).

The last value is remembered.
print.mismatch: ⚠ Tape width conflict: the printer was last configured with {printer_mm} mm, the editor is set to {scene_mm} mm. Make sure the loaded tape matches the editor setting – otherwise the P700 blinks red. Tip: disable 'Only print if the tape width matches' to print anyway.
